newsitem.title: UK: Sedgwick seeks NY Stock Exchange listing.
newsitem.headline: Sedgwick seeks NY Stock Exchange listing.

text.p: British insurer Sedgwick Group plc said on Tuesday it is seeking a listing of American Depository Shares (ADSs), representing its ordinary shares, on the New York Stock Exchange.
Sedgwick's existing ADSs are currently traded in the United States' over-the-counter market.

In a statement, Sedgwick said trading of the ADSs, which is subject to final approval of the New York Stock Exchange and the declaration of effectiveness by the Securities and Exchange Commission of a registration statement, is expected to commence in June 1997.
The company said a U.S. listing is a "logical step for the company", which has over 40 percent of its revenues and employees based in North America.
